name: Sporton International Inc.
summary: Sporton International Inc. provides product testing and certification services in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers mobile device services, including design consultation, training, testing, and certification that allow its customers to acquire certificates and promote products. It also provides EMC compatibility, safety, radio device, cellphone handset, and NCC certification test services, as well as sells anti-magnetic components. Sporton International Inc. was founded in 1986 and is headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan.
